name: WF-14 — Publication de Cours sous Validation

parameters.jsCode:
// runOnceForEachItem
const data = $json;
const now = new Date().toISOString();

const slug = (data.course_title || '')
  .toLowerCase()
  .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
  .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
  .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
  .substring(0, 80);

const formation = {
  title: data.course_title,
  slug,
  description: data.course_title,
  longDescription: '',
  coverImage: '',
  level: 'debutant',
  price: 0,
  promoPrice: 0,
  duration: data.duration_display || (data.estimated_hours + 'h'),
  modules: data.modules,
  category: 'Marketing Digital',
  tags: ['marketing digital', 'formation', 'afrique'],
  students: 0,
  rating: 0,
  status: 'draft',
  featured: false,
  certificateEnabled: true,
  metaTitle: data.course_title,
  metaDescription: data.course_title,
  focusKeyword: '',
  ogTitle: data.course_title,
  ogDescription: '',
  ogImage: '',
  noIndex: false,
  createdAt: now
};

return {
  json: {
    formation,
    slug,
    ids: data.ids,
    total_modules: data.total_modules,
    total_lessons: data.total_lessons,
    estimated_hours: data.estimated_hours,
    prompt: data.thumbnail_prompt,
    type: 'formation',
    dimensions: '1920x1080',
    context: 'Cours en ligne marketing digital Afrique francophone',
    for_workflow: 'wf14'
  }
};

// runOnceForEachItem
return { json: { prompt: $json.prompt, dimensions: $json.dimensions || '1920x1080', type: $json.type || 'formation', context: $json.context, for_workflow: $json.for_workflow, slug: $json.slug, formation_passthrough: $json.formation, ids: $json.ids, total_modules: $json.total_modules, total_lessons: $json.total_lessons, estimated_hours: $json.estimated_hours } };
